summary: Jeffry Deardorff, 72, of Hartsel, died in a ~1,000-foot fall while descending Crestone Needle after summiting ~11 a.m. Friday; Custer County SAR began searching Sunday with a Flight for Life helicopter and spotted the body ~1:15 p.m. at the base of Crestone Peak near Cottonwood Lake; no suspicious circumstances.
location: Crestone Needle descent / base of Crestone Peak near Cottonwood Lake
responding_agency: Custer County SAR; Custer County Sheriff's Office; Flight for Life
notes: Incident date pinned to Friday 2020-09-25 via Custer County SAR 14ers.com post ("summit ... approximately noon Friday (9/25/20)") + Saturday 2020-09-26 search start and Sunday 2020-09-27 body recovery in the Mountain Mail article; Saguache County is the incident county (Crestone Needle in Saguache County), Custer County SAR ran the response (Custer County access point).
